sentences.en: The principal theme of the book is the American Revolution.
sentences.zh: 这本书的主要主题是美国革命。

sentences.en: There are themes that are always present in his books.
sentences.zh: 在他的书中总有一些恒常的主题。

sentences.en: Doctor Sir, please write an Odia song in this theme.
sentences.zh: 医生先生，请在这个主题上写一首奥里亚语的歌。

senses.zh: 主题，主旨；主题曲，主旋律；主题公园，主题餐厅等
